market_outlook.short_term: Volatile and choppy. Iran-US conflict keeps oil elevated and bonds under pressure. S&P 500 likely range-bound as bargain buyers (headline 32) offset geopolitical risk. Tech may see continued rotation from chips to software. JOLTS weakness could delay Fed tightening but oil-driven inflation complicates the path. Expect 2-4% volatility in equities and 30-50bp moves in 10Y yields.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. M&A supercycle and AI capex provide structural tailwinds for quality equities. However, $40T US debt, persistent inflation from energy, and consumer spending softness cap multiple expansion. Geopolitical fragmentation (Iran, Russia-Ukraine wheat) adds tail risk. Favor AI infrastructure, energy, M&A beneficiaries, and hard assets over broad market beta.
